description: Check your own invoice against 21 published Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 rules, and whether the customer's Peppol address is registered; each finding names the rule and the fix. A listed subset, not the official validator. Free, no token.

buyerReference.description: The reference the customer asked you to put on the invoice (BT-10). Peppol requires this OR an order reference.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. BE.

endpointId.description: The party's Peppol address — the identifier the network delivers to, e.g. a Belgian enterprise number.

endpointScheme.description: The four-digit EAS code the address is stated under, e.g. "0208" for a Belgian enterprise number.

lineNetAmount.description: The line total excluding VAT, when you already computed it.

vatPercent.description: The VAT rate on this line, as a percentage, e.g. 21.
